question: The Green Revolution in India started in _______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1960s**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• The Green Revolution was started in the period 1960s.
 
• It commenced in India in the year 1960s under the premiership of Congress leader Lal Bahadur Shastri.
 
• It is also known as the Third Agricultural Revolution.
 
• Norman Borlaug is known as the Father of the Green Revolution in the World and he received Nobel Peace Prize in the year 197
